source_boundary: Candidate source categories only; no bank source access or data ingestion has been verified or enabled.

global_controls.purpose_limitation: Only bank-side fraud-risk pattern detection and human review support; no guilt determination or automatic payment blocking.
global_controls.data_minimization: Use derived features wherever possible; raw identifiers are prohibited by default.
global_controls.retention: No retention period approved in this contract; define minimum necessary retention with the bank data owner and counsel.
global_controls.access_control: Role-based bank-internal access, least privilege, audit logging and separation of duties required.
global_controls.cross_bank: Disabled; any future interbank sharing requires separate legal basis, agreement, security design and approval.
global_controls.source_quality: Every source field needs owner, schema, timestamp, provenance, quality, freshness and deletion policy.
global_controls.legal_status: No legal basis is presumed. The exact Uzbek legal basis, Central Bank rules, bank secrecy, personal-data requirements and payment-system obligations must be checked for each source and purpose.
